tools.name: tool_smith
tools.description: Run a TypeScript function body in a child process and return one value, or list the saved functions of the library. Saved functions are reusable files called as fn.<name>(input) inside a run. The script runs with full interpreter privileges: the nested allow-list limits only the tools.* bridge, not what the script itself can do.

filters.description: Case-insensitive substrings matched on function name and description.

input.description: JSON data bound to the input variable.
